entries.name: FORMLABS_CLIENT_ID
entries.description: The client ID of Formlabs Developer API credentials made for KaratOS. KaratOS uses it only to ask Formlabs for a token.
howToGet: Signed in to Formlabs Dashboard with the account the printers are registered to, open the Developer page (dashboard.formlabs.com/#developer) and create new credentials named KaratOS.
Copy the client ID straight into the host's secret store.

entries.name: FORMLABS_CLIENT_SECRET
entries.description: The client secret of those credentials. Formlabs tokens can't be limited to reading, so KaratOS sends the token only with GET requests for print runs.
howToGet: Formlabs shows the secret when the credentials are made. Copy it straight into the host's secret store. Never paste it into chat or an issue.
To cut KaratOS off, delete the credentials on the Developer page.
